correctness.rationale: For b=Uᵀ(x−p₀), the normal equation on an edge in direction i gives foot coordinate (bᵢ−Σgᵢⱼεⱼ)/gᵢᵢ. Maximizing the left endpoint and minimizing the right endpoint independently over the fixed binary coordinates gives precisely (Lᵢ,Hᵢ). Center the coordinates at 1/2: set y=b−G1/2. The edge conditions are |yᵢ|<δᵢ/2. On a face with free indices I, let zᵢ=yᵢ−Σ_{j∉I}gᵢⱼ(εⱼ−1/2); then |zᵢ|<(gᵢᵢ−Σ_{j∈I,j≠i}|gᵢⱼ|)/2. The affine Jacobi map tᵢ↦(zᵢ−Σ_{j∈I,j≠i}gᵢⱼtⱼ)/gᵢᵢ maps the closed centered half-cube strictly into its interior and is a sup-norm contraction by strict dominance. Its unique fixed point is the centered projection foot. I=[d] gives interiority; vertices are automatic. Nonpositive δᵢ makes the strict edge interval empty, including equality. The image box is centered at p₀+U1/2 with volume ratio ∏δᵢ/det G. The equiangular determinant (1−c)²(1+2c) gives both stated rational examples and the c=1/2 failure.
residual_risks: The packaged finite verification is corroboration only and was not executed; the all-real result is established analytically.

originality.rationale: The all-face kernel is prior, and the edge-strip characterization in the plane is already given by Pavlík. The distinct result here is the arbitrary-dimensional edge sufficiency for skew parallelotopes, with the Gram box, exact row-dominance threshold and determinant probability. In the checked prior results none provides those higher-dimensional conclusions or an evaluated formula that subsumes them.
residual_risks: Unindexed treatments in projection geometry or inverse matrix theory may use a different formulation; the bounded search cannot certify priority.
Same-day cataloguing is not a priority determination.

value.rationale: The result classifies admissible centers for a natural all-dimensional family, including arbitrary mixed signs and unequal generator lengths. It replaces a growing set of face checks by 2d sharp scalar inequalities and gives the exact uniform probability as the center set collapses at the shear threshold.
residual_risks: No criterion for general combinatorial cubes or higher-dimensional orthogonal tiling is established.
